produtos.name: TONYKART 401 T DIRECT DRIVE KART CHASSIS
produtos.description:
OTK Kart Group Tony Kart Racing Kart, KA100 Yamaha, TaG, Leopard, Rotax Chassis for Junior and Senior Classes

100cc / 125cc Single Speed Chassis, Rear Brake Only, Engine Sold Separately

Shown with optional equipment – Engine, Radiator and Tires Sold Separately

The Racer 401, in its evolution called “T”, confirms to be the top-range Tony Kart chassis. Available, as always, in the single-gear, shifter and DD2 versions, it introduces several new features, born from the synergy between OTK Kart Group’s R&D department and the Tony Kart Racing Team. The key features of this historic model remain unchanged: the frame entirely made of Ø 30 mm tubes and a top manufacturing quality.

The Racer 401 is the spearhead of Tony Kart’s success-rich history. Throughout its “sporting career,” from 2004 to the present, the flagship chassis of the Prevalle brand has been able to win more than 10 world titles and numerous victories at the international level. The desire to continue this path studded with victories also with the new “T” version, has led the R&D team of the OTK Kart Group to introduce several innovations, among which the new braking systems, BWD for the single-gear classes and BWZ for the shifter classes stand out, as well as the new M11 fairings. To achieve outstanding results, however, it is essential to work on even the smallest details. For this reason, among the improvements introduced, the Racer 401 T also features a new chain tensioner, made of aluminum, attached to the bearing support. Tony Kart also renews itself aesthetically, with new graphics for the fairing stickers kit.

The quest for an ever-increasing aerodynamic efficiency led OTK Kart Group’s R&D department to develop the new M11 fairing kit, which complies with the current FIA regulations. Data obtained by OTK Kart Group’s R&D department through CFD computerized simulations and wind tunnel testing, combined with data gathered through on-track testing by the Tony Kart Racing Team, led to the birth of a new front spoiler and a new fairing with unique designs that guarantee a substantial reduction in aerodynamic drag, resulting in better performances on-track. Coupled with the two parts named M11, we find the side bumpers and the rear protection of the M10 kit, introduced already with the previous homologation, as well as the full-coverage floorplate that maximizes aerodynamic efficiency. The entire package, moreover, is decorated with stickers with a new, more attractive design, but faithful as always to the colors and style of the brand from Prevalle.

The novelty of this model, top of Tony Kart range, also includes other important components such as modern and efficient OTK adjustable aluminum pedals and MXJ magnesium wheels, of recent production, born by important challenging and effective research and development studies.
Among the main novelties launched by Tony Kart, the new BWD braking system, reserved for Direct Drive classes, both Junior and Senior, undoubtedly stands out. The design activity carried out by the R&D department focused on the use of the highest quality materials, aimed at ensuring an extremely high degree of component efficiency. The unprecedented concept behind the project has resulted in a braking system able of highly improving heat dissipation, consequently reducing the temperature at the brake oil charge, ensuring drivers fully efficient braking consistent over time and in all track conditions. The BWD system is available in two versions: with a 180 mm or 206 mm diameter disc, according to the needs.

The evolution of the Racer 401 T also passes through several confirmations, such as the multi-adjustable pedals and the inclined steering wheel hub from the OTK Kart Parts line, which guarantee a nearly tailor-made driving position. Completing the package of parts kept unchanged from the past is the HGS steering wheel, whose high rubber handgrip significantly reduces driver effort while driving. The match of these pars, designed together with Tony Kart Racing Team drivers, guarantees, in a simple way, the achievement of an ideal driving position for kart drivers of all sizes.

Kart must be shipped by truck or picked up at Comet, freight cost is an estimate and may be more than estimated depending on destination

Compkart is a little more loose than the other brands we have tested, making it very easy to drive on tight and twisty tracks and more challenging on fast track and on long corner radius.

Overall Compkarts are a great option!

produtos.name: AIM Mychron SmartyCam 3 Sport Including data hub
produtos.description:
SmartyCam 3 Sport 84 degree FOV (wide angle)

Available with or without Two Port Data Hub

Pick up your SmartyCam 3 SPORT and put it whatever you want: its compact design is perfectly shaped to take up as little space as possible into your racing cockpit. The new quarter turn locking system assures the best performance in terms of safety and closing speed. The new SmartyCam 3 SPORT camera has been designed for motorsports with a single purpose, Providing great videos including all the information you need. The SmartyCam 3 SPORT camera overlays all the data from both GPS and AiM data loggers connected to your ECU. The perfect camera designed for club racing or karting.

Note: This camera is not designed to be used as a stand alone unit. Must be connected to a data logger with 12v power or 2 port data hub with external 12v power supply.
SmartyCam 3 Sport 84 degree FOV (wide angle)

Global shutter CMOS sensor
1920×1080 FHD 30 fps H.264
Display resolution 128×125 pixel
Lens angle: 84 degree
Internal, rechargeable lithium battery 350mAh
9-15 volt external power
Support for up to 2TB micro SD card
-10C degree / +60C working temperature range
Auto power ON/OFF
Auto Start/Stop recording
CAN connection to all AiM systems
RaceStudio3 (RS3) Configuration

High quality with small size video files – Generic HD cameras are focused on the highest pixel number. The result is that their video files are far too large, taking too much memory. SmartyCam 3 SPORT videos have the same quality as other FHD cameras but their files are smaller because the H.264 compression system parameters have been optimized to a perfect balance between video quality and file size.

No “Wave Effect” with Global Shutter CMOS – Engine rumble causes vibrations, which are a big problem for video recording. You will never experience again that seasick “wave effect” you get watching videos recorded by a generic camera when the car rolls at 7,000 RPM. SmartyCam 3 SPORT cameras have been designed for that environment and for those vibrations. “Wave effect” is just a distant memory

Designed for the extreme – An on-board camera designed for motorsport must guarantee great resistance against the extreme working conditions typical of racing and against the most adverse weather, such as: strong and prolonged vibrations, continuous rain and extremely high and low temperatures. IP65 waterproof and made in machinery molded aluminum, just like many competition car parts.

Automatic Start & Stop – You are on the starting grid, ready to sprint, your adrenaline reaching the climax: the last thing you can worry about is… switching on the camera. You have other things to worry about. SmartyCam 3 is aware of that. That is why it switches on/off automatically and starts/stops recording the same way.

Full internal datalogger – All the data received from CAN and internal sensors are recorded in .mov files produced at the end of your test, your SD (or MSD) Card contains all the information you need for a deep data analysis. SD card sold separately.

produtos.name: AIM Mychron SmartyCam 3 Sport – No data hub
produtos.description:
SmartyCam 3 Sport 84 degree FOV (wide angle)

Available with or without Two Port Data Hub

Pick up your SmartyCam 3 SPORT and put it whatever you want: its compact design is perfectly shaped to take up as little space as possible into your racing cockpit. The new quarter turn locking system assures the best performance in terms of safety and closing speed. The new SmartyCam 3 SPORT camera has been designed for motorsports with a single purpose, Providing great videos including all the information you need. The SmartyCam 3 SPORT camera overlays all the data from both GPS and AiM data loggers connected to your ECU. The perfect camera designed for club racing or karting.

Note: This camera is not designed to be used as a stand alone unit. Must be connected to a data logger with 12v power or 2 port data hub with external 12v power supply.
SmartyCam 3 Sport 84 degree FOV (wide angle)

Global shutter CMOS sensor
1920×1080 FHD 30 fps H.264
Display resolution 128×125 pixel
Lens angle: 84 degree
Internal, rechargeable lithium battery 350mAh
9-15 volt external power
Support for up to 2TB micro SD card
-10C degree / +60C working temperature range
Auto power ON/OFF
Auto Start/Stop recording
CAN connection to all AiM systems
RaceStudio3 (RS3) Configuration

High quality with small size video files – Generic HD cameras are focused on the highest pixel number. The result is that their video files are far too large, taking too much memory. SmartyCam 3 SPORT videos have the same quality as other FHD cameras but their files are smaller because the H.264 compression system parameters have been optimized to a perfect balance between video quality and file size.

No “Wave Effect” with Global Shutter CMOS – Engine rumble causes vibrations, which are a big problem for video recording. You will never experience again that seasick “wave effect” you get watching videos recorded by a generic camera when the car rolls at 7,000 RPM. SmartyCam 3 SPORT cameras have been designed for that environment and for those vibrations. “Wave effect” is just a distant memory

Designed for the extreme – An on-board camera designed for motorsport must guarantee great resistance against the extreme working conditions typical of racing and against the most adverse weather, such as: strong and prolonged vibrations, continuous rain and extremely high and low temperatures. IP65 waterproof and made in machinery molded aluminum, just like many competition car parts.

Automatic Start & Stop – You are on the starting grid, ready to sprint, your adrenaline reaching the climax: the last thing you can worry about is… switching on the camera. You have other things to worry about. SmartyCam 3 is aware of that. That is why it switches on/off automatically and starts/stops recording the same way.

Full internal datalogger – All the data received from CAN and internal sensors are recorded in .mov files produced at the end of your test, your SD (or MSD) Card contains all the information you need for a deep data analysis. SD card sold separately.

produtos.description:
The EZGP mount is one of the most intricate products Odenthal has ever come out with. There is a great deal of machining that goes into these pieces. The camera mounts are precisely machined from 6061-T6 Aluminum which is aerospace grade material. Odenthal machines these to very tight tolerances to ensure every assembly fits perfect and won’t fail. They also use the best hardware to prevent rust or anything that could compromise the ability of the user to use the piece to its full potential.

The Go Pro Mount mounts to the seat strut and is available in four versions. The “short” 7″ bar version is for Air Cooled Karts and is available for a single or dual camera.
